archive_selection.rule: the v1 phase-cost selection (min, median, max by route bytes), in that order; retain-N uses the first N

failed_build_reference.note: maximum resident set size and peak memory footprint are different quantities: resident pages in RAM versus the kernel footprint ledger, which also counts compressed and swapped anonymous memory. Neither is evidence for the other. user_s is 96.4% of real_s: the process was on CPU in user space almost the whole time.

footprint_projection.basis: network-loaded footprint of retain-3 plus the mean per-archive footprint growth of retain-3, times the 30 archives the month's units resolve to; the unit loop's own records are ignored

hypothesis: retaining all parsed archives and their indexes before the unit loop is what grows the index build's memory; releasing one archive at a time removes that growth without changing any output

index_rebuild.basis: the b5e1564 unit loop called find_demand_archives without _archive_index once per daily unit, and each such call runs _archives_for_build_key; the median of three single-build processes times 1,950

method.retain: loop structure of _raw_index_records: every archive parsed and indexed first, then every unit
method.stream: per archive: parse, index, evaluate its units, del, gc.collect(); diagnostic only
